args.lesson: Bounded STOP: 0 of 3 prize candidates qualified (2026-11-14). Topcoder's listing is a JavaScript shell and a guessed API URL gave 404, so its inventory is unobserved (its account requirement is assumed, not read). Al Zimmermann's contests are both postponed and pay gift cards. The Hutter Prize is open with no deadline and objective scoring, but its rules do not state AI permission, entry is by email to named people (no outgoing path; founder identity needed), and it needs a 1 GB corpus and ~100 h runs we cannot do. What worked: static official rule pages gave quotable terms in one FETCH each. What failed: JS-rendered listings. Next time, check that a prize page is static and that submission is not by account or email before counting it as a candidate. Scope: these three only; not a claim that no feasible prize exists.
